customInstructions.text: If a cookie-consent banner is visible right now, click its accept/agree button once to dismiss it. If no such banner is visible, do nothing for this step.

customInstructions: Change the language to English using the language switcher in the top right. Verify the page text actually changed to English before moving on — if it's still Spanish, click the switcher again.
Select the visit date from the calendar — use the "Date" value given below.

customInstructions.text: Select the number of "General + Exhibitions time pass" as pax, using the "Pax count" value below for the quantity. If that ticket type is not available, select "General" pax instead, same quantity.

customInstructions: Click to open the time-slot picker and select a time slot (if the exact time isn't available, it's fine to pick a slot up to 45 minutes after the requested time).

The time-slot picker is a popup/modal that stays open after you click a time -- it does not close itself. Close/confirm it now: look for a Confirm/Aceptar/checkmark button inside the popup and click it, or click the already-selected time slot a second time, or click the X/close control on the popup. Do not proceed to the next step until this popup is fully closed and you can see the main checkout page again.
Click the Continue/Continuar button to proceed past ticket selection.
Skip all add-ons on the next step — do not add an audio guide or any other extra. Click Continue/Continuar again.
On the customer details form, fill ONLY the First name field, using the "First name" value given below. Do not touch any other field on this form yet.
On the customer details form, fill ONLY the Last name field, using the "Last name" value given below. Do not touch any other field on this form yet.
On the customer details form, fill ONLY the Email field, using the "Email" value given below. Do not touch any other field on this form yet.
On the customer details form, fill ONLY the Address line field, using the "Address line" value given below. Do not touch any other field on this form yet.
On the customer details form, fill ONLY the City field, using the "City" value given below. Do not touch any other field on this form yet.
On the customer details form, fill ONLY the Postal code field, using the "Postal code" value given below. Do not touch any other field on this form yet.
On the customer details form, if there is a Country field, set it to the "Country" value given below.
Proceed toward the payment page. Do not do anything on the payment page itself — see the safety rule below.

finalAction.description: Proceed to the payment page and stop there
